variant: XC820.3 (3.5 m horizontal, 5.5 m vertical reach)
name: Befard XC820.3 glazing robot
summary: Radio-controlled wheeled glazing robot with eight vacuum cups on a hydraulic boom that lifts panes and windows of up to 820 kg and sets them into frames or facades. Made by Befard in Poland; the XC820.3 is the longest-reach version of the XC820.

germany.statusNote: A new 2026 XC820.3 is listed on the German machinery marketplace Maschinensucher.de at a fixed price of €34,900 plus VAT, located at Befard's address in Kozy, Poland. Befard also names GreenLifter in Fürth as its sales partner for Germany; GreenLifter's own site does not list the XC820.

priceEur.note: Fixed price plus VAT for a new unit, build year 2026.

sellers.name: Befard (listing on Maschinensucher.de)
sellers.note: Listing location Ul. Pod Grapą 4, 43-340 Kozy, Poland (Befard's address); seller contact through the marketplace form.

sellers.name: GreenLifter
sellers.note: Boxdorfer Str. 35, 90765 Fürth. Named by Befard as its German sales partner; GreenLifter's website shows Befard branding but lists cranes, vacuum lifters and transporters, not the XC820.

notes: Arm = hydraulic boom with a vacuum-cup beam; options include hydraulic side shift and beam rotation (each reduces load by 100 kg), hook and forks.
Remote-controlled by an operator; not autonomous.
Maker says the robust wheels run on uneven ground without losing stability (roughGround is a maker claim); options include twin front wheels and puncture-proof solid tyres.
Drive type (electric or combustion) and runtime are not stated on the pages read.
